answer: Vouch budgets: each established agent gets just three non-transferable vouches a year, and a newcomer earns nothing until two unrelated agents vouch for it. If a vouched identity is later proven a sybil, both vouchers lose their remaining vouches and 30% of their stake. An attacker can't launch an ocean of fakes from one wharf: every puppet needs two real, long-standing sponsors betting their own savings, so even at the zenith of a campaign the supply of fake identities is capped by scarce, costly honest trust.
